entries.land_location_as_stated: nestled in a rural setting, close to a beautiful, trout-stocked stream, and ruby gem mines; Franklin is in the heart of the Smokies
entries.description: Rural guest house (a private home) near Franklin, NC, close to a trout stream and ruby gem mines. It offers a private room and bath at $35 a night, and also arranges women-owned vacation cottages and homes in the area at $200-$300 a week. Welcomes girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: VANGUARD ENTERPRISES PO Box 1082, Franklin, NC 28734 (704)524-4453. Vanguard Guest House is a private home nestled in a rural setting, close to a beautiful, trout-stocked stream, and ruby gem mines. Accommodations include private room and bath, full kitchen privileges, shared common areas, living room with fireplace, and spacious deck (constructed by local women!). Warm, relaxed, friendly atmosphere where everyone is free to be themselves. Rates: $35 per night. Also, private, women-owned vacation cottages and homes in this area are available. Various styles, views, and locations. Most can house minimally four persons, and have decks and fireplaces. They have fully equipped kitchens and linens are provided. Smoking is an outside activity in most of the cottages. Rates range from $200 to $300 per week. Franklin is in the heart of the Smokies and a wonderful place to base your vacation. We welcome girl/boy children.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: defined by what it offers visitors ("Vanguard Guest House", rates per night and per week). The mailing address is a PO box, so land street and zip are blank. Land city Franklin is inferred from "Franklin is in the heart of the Smokies and a wonderful place to base your vacation". Lesbian women are coded because the directory is for lesbians and the listing welcomes guests. Girl children and Boy children come from "We welcome girl/boy children". No smoking indoors is noted but is not a substance-free rule.

entries.description: A furnished cabin in Pisgah National Forest, NC, rented year round at $45 a day by one lesbian owner based in Asheville. It has antiques, women's artwork and books, a fireplace, phone, kitchen and bath, and is in the woods and accessible.
entries.raw_text: BEAR'S CABIN c/o Ruth Bone, 70 St Dunstans Circle, Asheville, NC 28803 (704)254-0024 (after 5:30pm). Cozy and magical cabin in Pisgah National Forest. Exquisite. Private. Safe. Totally and tastefully furnished with antiques, women's artwork, women's books, waterbed, fireplace (and oil heat), phone, kitchen, bath. Year round. $45/day. Asheville is a resort area with a large lesbian population. I am/have: 1 lesbian, accessible, woods.
entries.notes: Type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule: "I am/have: 1 lesbian". Renting the cabin to guests does not change the type. The mailing address is a city street address in Asheville, while the cabin is described as "in Pisgah National Forest", so land street, city and zip are blank. Land state NC is taken from the national forest location and the mailing state. num_residents is blank because the owner's address is in Asheville and the listing does not say anyone lives at the cabin; the questionnaire count is 1 lesbian. "accessible" is a checked questionnaire item, not presented as a purpose, so Disabled women is not coded. Lesbian women are coded because the listing describes a lesbian owner.

entries.land_location_as_stated: on the headwaters of the Etowah River, deep in the woods
entries.description: Women's campground on the headwaters of the Etowah River in Georgia, with primitive river-front campsites, tables, fire rings and an outhouse. Women live on the land, and friendly dogs are welcome.
entries.raw_text: SWIFTWATERS CAMPGROUND FOR WOMEN Box 2068, Dahlonega, GA 30533 (404)864-3229. Swiftwaters is a quiet place to camp on the headwaters of the Etowah River, deep in the woods. Plenty of tables, fire rings, and primitive river-front campsites. We welcome dogs (if friendly). We have: outhouse, woods, camping space, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: a campground defined by what it offers visitors ("a quiet place to camp"). "Box 2068" has no road, so it is treated as a PO box and land street and zip are blank. Land state GA is inferred from the mailing state and the Etowah River location. num_residents is blank because "women living on the land" gives no count. Lesbian women are coded because, from 1986 on, "women" is read as lesbians. Dogs are welcome "(if friendly)".

entries.description: A small residential lesbian community on the ocean in Vilano Beach, St Augustine, FL: 10 separately owned cottages and a cultural/spiritual center with four guest bedrooms, a feminist library and a health food store. Only lesbians may rent or own. Members, including non-lesbian women, may stay in the center. The center bans smoking, alcohol and meat on its main floor, and there is no nudity. It has 15 resident lesbians and 90 members from around the country, and welcomes new members/residents, girl children and non-lesbian women visitors.
entries.raw_text: THE PAGODA 2854 Coastal Hwy Vilano Beach, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small residential lesbian community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center, as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in the building. No nudity on our property or on the beach directly in front of us. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We are/have: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: "a small residential lesbian community" living on the land. The street address is treated as the land. num_residents is 15 from "15 resident lesbians"; the 90 non-resident members are not counted. Non-lesbian women are coded from "nonlesbian women visitors" and "lesbian/nonlesbian members". Girl children are coded from "girl children". Lesbian separatism is coded from "Only lesbians can rent or own". Spirituality/ritual and Archives/cultural work are coded from "cultural/spiritual center" and "feminist library". Recovery/substance-free is coded from the stated rule "no alcohol on main floor", although that rule is limited to the main floor of the center. The raw text prints "membeps" with a smudged letter; it is transcribed as "members".

entries.land_location_as_stated: Lots of woods, birds, tropical vegetation, racoons, cats
entries.description: A bed and breakfast in a private home in Miami with one suite and one double room that opens onto a deck. The grounds have woods, birds and tropical vegetation. It is smoke-free and presents itself as an alternative to male-owned hotels, convenient to the airport, beaches, the Everglades and the Keys road.
entries.raw_text: TROPICAL DREAMS BED'N'BREAKFAST c/o C Brewer, 7600 SW 50 Ave, Miami, FL 33143 (305)666-5203. We're a private home offering an alternative to male-owned commercial hotels. We have one suite consisting of a bedroom, full bath and living room with a sofa bed. Also one double room with (sometimes shared) bath. This one has a wall of sliding glass doors that open out onto our deck. Lots of woods, birds, tropical vegetation, racoons, cats. Quiet, restful, smoke-free. Convenient to airport, beaches, Everglades, all tourist attractions and the road to Key West.
entries.notes: Included as a row because it describes a private home with its own grounds ("Lots of woods, birds, tropical vegetation"), though this is borderline under the rule excluding town guest rooms with no land. By that same rule, the nearby urban Orlando bed and breakfasts with no land described (SAFARI SOUTH, CLADDAGH COTTAGE B & B) were not extracted as rows. Type Retreat/Gathering Space: a bed and breakfast defined by what it offers guests. The street address is treated as the land. No welcome list is given, so accepted_groups is empty. "smoke-free" is a tobacco rule only, so Recovery/substance-free is not coded.

entries.land_location_as_stated: just off I-71, 50 miles south of Cleveland, 90 miles north of Columbus
entries.description: Rural guest place in West Salem, OH, near Amish country, run by a household. It offers two guest rooms, platform tents, a cabin, tenting places, a picnic shelter, gardens, a pond and woods, plus a summer music festival. Overnight stays are by donation, and work exchange is available. Welcomes girl children and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: DEGREES OF FREEDOM 10055 Kline Rd RD #2, W Salem, OH 44287 (just off I-71, 50 miles south of Cleveland, 90 miles north of Columbus). We have two guest rooms and bath, two platform tents, a cabin that sleeps four, picnic shelter with fireplace, gardens (herb, vegetable, fruit, and flower), a pond for swimming, fishing, boating, skating, and studying pond life, places for tenting, woods, and a summer music festival July 22-24, '88. We're near Amish country, herb farms. You can cook out, go to town to eat (1 mile), cook in, or take potluck with the household. Donations appreciated for overnight stays (guest room $11, cabin $7, platform tent $4, camping $2/person). Work exchange available. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: defined by what it offers visitors (guest rooms, cabin, tents, camping, "Donations appreciated for overnight stays"). A resident household exists ("take potluck with the household"), but its size is not given, so num_residents is blank. The address is a rural route (RD #2), so all four parts are copied to land. Non-lesbian women and Girl children are coded from "We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women". Lesbian women are coded because this is the lesbian directory and the listing welcomes visitors. Archives/cultural work is coded for the "summer music festival" the place hosts. The gardens are not presented as a self-sufficiency goal, so Farming is not coded.

entries.description: A small resort near Honor, MI, with three housekeeping cabins on a secluded lake one mile from Lake Michigan, offering swimming, hiking, canoeing, skiing and bird watching. It recently bought adjoining land, plans another cabin, and aims to build a women's community.
